injects.label: STARTEX situation
injects.text: STARTEX. Secure the sites your commander has prioritized and stay clear of the other force. The Marala First Front is active across the island: report every suspected device with an IED 9-line and every enemy team with a SALUTE. The mayor expects one team from each force at Town Hall this morning. Escalation is the commander's decision; avoid incidents.
injects.note: Send at STARTEX. No POC action.

injects.label: IED tip, south
injects.text: A farmer reports two men in work clothes burying a paint can at grid 18T TL 59719 21792 (40.81199, -77.84877), play square D6 before dawn. Treat it as a possible IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: Real IED prop at the point before STARTEX. Correct IED 9-line to the POC: POC reports Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). A team that walks onto the prop without a cordon: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: IED tip, east field
injects.text: A shepherd says his dog would not go near a spot at grid 18T TL 59840 22017 (40.81405, -77.84743), play square E2. He saw fresh digging and a length of wire. Treat it as a possible IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: Real IED prop at the point before STARTEX. Correct IED 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: Mayor invitation
injects.text: The mayor invites each force to Town Hall at grid 18T TL 59724 21852 (40.81254, -77.84874), play square D5. Blue Force: one team between 0620 and 0630. Red Force: one team between 0635 and 0645. Weapons stay outside the hall entrance. The mayor will ask what your force is doing to protect the island's farmers.
injects.note: Mayor role player at the town. Respectful answer and weapons outside: POC reports Good conduct (+5). Weapons carried in or the other wing's time ignored: Poor conduct (−5). The mayor gives the town code word to a respectful team.

injects.label: Injured shepherd
injects.text: A shepherd fell at grid 18T TL 59635 21799 (40.81203, -77.84977), play square C5 and cannot put weight on his left leg. His family asks the Coalition for help. Treat him and read a MEDEVAC 9-line to your POC. Once your POC confirms the 9-line, a MEDEVAC is inbound and your team may leave him in place and continue the mission.
injects.note: Role player at the point acting out a lower leg fracture. Treatment plus a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: POC reports Helped a civilian (+5). No escort needed: the team may leave the role player in place. Ignored for 25 minutes: no penalty, but the white cell may tell the mayor.

injects.label: Injured fisherman
injects.text: A fisherman walking home cut his forearm badly on wire at grid 18T TL 59862 22065 (40.81449, -77.84719), play square E2. He is bleeding and frightened. Treat him and read a MEDEVAC 9-line to your POC. Once your POC confirms the 9-line, a MEDEVAC is inbound and your team may leave him in place and continue the mission.
injects.note: Role player acting out a bleeding forearm cut. Treatment plus a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: Helped a civilian (+5). No escort needed: the team may leave the role player in place.

injects.label: Aid supply box off target (1)
injects.text: A humanitarian airdrop missed its drop zone. One Humanitarian Aid Supply Box landed near grid 18T TL 59681 21999 (40.81384, -77.84931), play square C3. The mayor asks for it to reach the Marala Town office. The first force to deliver it intact earns the town's thanks. Do not open it.
injects.note: One Humanitarian Aid Supply Box at the point (separate from the aid package cycle boxes). First wing to carry it to the town office intact: white cell adjustment, diplomatic +5, reason "Aid supply box delivered". Opened or damaged: Poor conduct.

injects.label: Suspicious pickup truck
injects.text: A pickup with no plates stopped near grid 18T TL 59643 21955 (40.81344, -77.84974), play square C3. Two men unloaded long crates, then drove north. Send a team to observe and report a SALUTE. Do not engage.
injects.note: [Optional] Militia role player(s) near the point for 15 minutes. A complete SALUTE posted on the board: white cell confirms as an activity report (+1). Shots or detention: Provocation.

injects.label: Men watching the airstrip
injects.text: Two men with binoculars are watching the airstrip from grid 18T TL 59742 22062 (40.81443, -77.84861), play square D2. They are not in uniform. Send a team to observe and report a SALUTE. Do not engage.
injects.note: [Optional] Militia role player(s) at the point for 15 minutes. Complete SALUTE: white cell confirms (+1). Shots or detention: Provocation.

injects.label: Downed pilot VIPER 21
injects.text: PERSONNEL RECOVERY. An F-16, call sign VIPER 21, went down north of the island. The pilot ejected; his beacon places him near grid 18T TL 59760 22102 (40.81480, -77.84841), play square D1, on the Red Force side. He has a leg injury and cannot walk: bring a litter. Authenticate before moving him: your team says THUNDER, he answers RIDGELINE. Send a MEDEVAC 9-line, then carry him on the litter to your casualty collection point. Avoid contact with Red Force.
injects.note: Role player at the point from 0634. He goes only with a team that gives THUNDER. Recovered to Blue Force HQ with a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: adjustment +3 points (reason "Personnel recovery"). If Red Force finds him first, see the Red Force sighting inject. Litter carry back is slow: about 15 minutes.

injects.label: Parachute sighting
injects.text: A herder saw a parachute come down near grid 18T TL 59760 22102 (40.81480, -77.84841), play square D1 a few minutes ago. A man in a flight suit is limping away from the landing spot. He is likely a Coalition pilot. Your commander decides: leave him, observe and report, or detain him. Detaining a foreign service member will raise tension. Escorting him unharmed to the mayor at Marala Town would be seen as a humanitarian act.
injects.note: Detained and taken to Red Force HQ: escalation +10 to Red Force (adjustment, reason "Detained Coalition pilot"). Escorted unharmed to the Marala Town office and handed to the mayor: Red Force diplomatic +10 (adjustment), and Blue Force may collect him there. Observed and reported only: SALUTE +1.

injects.label: Possible device, west field
injects.text: A patrol from another unit reports a suspicious bag left at grid 18T TL 59596 21786 (40.81190, -77.85023), play square B6. Treat it as a possible IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: HOAX. The bag holds a card reading HOAX. Correct cordon and 9-line: POC tells the team it was a hoax; Good conduct (+5) for a correct cordon. Walked onto it: no casualty, but report Poor conduct only if civilians were endangered.

injects.label: Possible device, northeast
injects.text: Villagers report a cooler left at grid 18T TL 59903 22015 (40.81405, -77.84668), play square F2 with a phone taped to the lid. Treat it as a possible IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: HOAX. Cooler with a HOAX card inside. Correct cordon and 9-line: POC tells the team it was a hoax; Good conduct (+5).

injects.label: Fuel leak at the depot
injects.text: A valve on the main tank at the Fuel Depot, grid 18T TL 59799 21941 (40.81335, -77.84789), play square E3, is leaking. The force holding the depot must send a team to close the valve and set a 10 m safety line within 10 minutes. If no force holds the depot, workers will handle it.
injects.note: [Optional] Site POC checks the holding wing's team: cones or tape for a 10 m line and the valve tag turned to CLOSED. Done in time: Good conduct (+5). Ignored: Poor conduct (−5). No holder: no action.

injects.label: Family needs escort
injects.text: A family of three is walking from the fields at grid 18T TL 59643 21955 (40.81344, -77.84974), play square C3 to Marala Town with their belongings. They are afraid of the militia. Any force may escort them safely to the Town Hall. Do not separate the family.
injects.note: [Optional] Two or three role players at the point. Escorted to the town office together: POC reports Helped a civilian (+5). First wing only.

injects.label: Downed crewman ROTOR 3
injects.text: PERSONNEL RECOVERY. A Red Force helicopter, call sign ROTOR 3, made a hard landing south of the island. A crewman with a head injury is near grid 18T TL 59635 21799 (40.81203, -77.84977), play square C5, on the Blue Force side. He is too dizzy to walk: bring a litter. Authenticate before moving him: your team says ANVIL, he answers MORNING STAR. Send a MEDEVAC 9-line, then carry him on the litter to your casualty collection point. Avoid contact with Blue Force.
injects.note: Role player at the point from 0654. He goes only with a team that gives ANVIL. Recovered to Red Force HQ with a correct MEDEVAC 9-line: adjustment +3 points (reason "Personnel recovery"). Litter carry back is long: about 15 minutes.

injects.label: Helicopter down nearby
injects.text: A farmer heard a helicopter come down hard south of the island. A man in a dark flight suit is sitting near grid 18T TL 59635 21799 (40.81203, -77.84977), play square C5, holding his head. He is likely a Red Force crewman. Your commander decides: leave him, observe and report, or detain him. Detaining a foreign service member will raise tension. Escorting him unharmed to the mayor would be seen as a humanitarian act.
injects.note: Detained and taken to Blue Force HQ: escalation +10 to Blue Force (adjustment, reason "Detained Red Force crewman"). Escorted unharmed to the mayor: Blue Force diplomatic +10 (adjustment). Observed and reported only: SALUTE +1.

injects.label: Change of command
injects.text: CHANGE OF COMMAND. Effective 0700, in every unit the deputy assumes the lead role and the outgoing leader becomes the deputy. Brief your replacement now: current site status, teams out and their tasks, pending reports and aid packages. The new commander confirms assumption of command to the AOC by message or radio by 0705.
injects.note: Sent at 0700 to both wings. Check that each wing confirms by 0705. Form 2 evaluators stay with the same role and evaluate the new leader from 0700.

injects.label: Militia weapons cache
injects.text: An intercepted call places a militia weapons cache hidden at grid 18T TL 59761 21896 (40.81294, -77.84832), play square D4, between Marala Town and the Fuel Depot. The first force to clear it on foot, or destroy it with a correct strike 9-line, removes it from play. Watch for a guard or a device near the cache.
injects.note: Cache prop (crate with training weapons) at the point. Cleared on foot: POC reports Militia cache cleared (+5, diplomatic +5). Strike: needs a correct strike 9-line and the commander's strike action. One clearance only.

injects.label: Elderly woman collapsed
injects.text: An elderly woman collapsed near grid 18T TL 59719 21792 (40.81199, -77.84877), play square D6 while carrying water. Neighbors say she has had nothing to drink since yesterday. Treat her and read a MEDEVAC 9-line to your POC. Once your POC confirms the 9-line, a MEDEVAC is inbound and your team may leave her in place and continue the mission.
injects.note: Role player acting out heat exhaustion and dehydration. Treatment plus correct MEDEVAC 9-line: Helped a civilian (+5). No escort needed: the team may leave the role player in place.

injects.label: Injured farm worker
injects.text: A farm worker was hurt when a cart tipped over at grid 18T TL 59854 21940 (40.81336, -77.84723), play square E3. His friends say he cannot breathe deeply and his ribs hurt. Treat him and read a MEDEVAC 9-line to your POC. Once your POC confirms the 9-line, a MEDEVAC is inbound and your team may leave him in place and continue the mission.
injects.note: Role player acting out a chest injury with painful breathing. Treatment plus correct MEDEVAC 9-line: Helped a civilian (+5). No escort needed: the team may leave the role player in place.

injects.label: Aid supply box off target (2)
injects.text: A second Humanitarian Aid Supply Box came down off target near grid 18T TL 59757 21813 (40.81219, -77.84833), play square D5. The first force to deliver it intact to the Marala Town office earns the town's thanks. Do not open it.
injects.note: Humanitarian Aid Supply Box at the point. First wing to deliver it intact: adjustment, diplomatic +5, reason "Aid supply box delivered".

injects.label: Command wire found
injects.text: A patrol found a thin command wire on the ground at grid 18T TL 59643 21955 (40.81344, -77.84974), play square C3, on the approach to Radar Ridge. Treat it as an IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: Real IED prop with wire. Correct 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: Pressure plate reported
injects.text: Villagers saw a man bury something flat at grid 18T TL 59709 22076 (40.81455, -77.84901), play square C2, north of the airstrip, then walk away fast. Treat it as an IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 20 minutes.
injects.note: Real IED prop (flat board with wires). Correct 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: New key site: Pump Station
injects.text: The island's water pump station at grid 18T TL 59657 22050 (40.81430, -77.84961), play square C2 is now a key site. Whoever holds it controls the town's water supply. It can be captured with a code word earned at the site, like the other sites.
injects.note: Before sending: Map tab, waypoint queue, Interest Point / Potential Mid Game New Site #4, Make site. Name it Pump Station, timer 15, and enter the Pump Station capture and defense words from the Station Keys. The station POC must already be in place with the Pump Station cards and a tarp.

injects.label: Armed men on the move
injects.text: Three armed men in civilian clothes are moving south through grid 18T TL 59681 21999 (40.81384, -77.84931), play square C3. Their identity is unknown. Observe and report a SALUTE. Do not fire unless fired upon.
injects.note: [Optional] Militia role players moving slowly south for 10 minutes. Complete SALUTE: activity report +1. Any force that fires first: Fired first (escalation +20, diplomatic −15). Provocation if teams of both wings crowd each other.

injects.label: Second device, south
injects.text: The same farmer who called this morning reports a second device at grid 18T TL 59635 21799 (40.81203, -77.84977), play square C5. Treat it as an IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 15 minutes.
injects.note: Real IED prop. Correct 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: Device near Red Force HQ
injects.text: A Red Force supply runner saw freshly disturbed ground with a wire at grid 18T TL 59862 22065 (40.81449, -77.84719), play square E2, close to your headquarters. Treat it as an IED. Do not approach closer than 25 m. Establish a cordon, keep civilians out, and send an IED 9-line through your POC. Your POC confirms the 9-line before it is reported. Report within 15 minutes.
injects.note: Real IED prop. Correct 9-line: Real IED cleared (+2, diplomatic +5). Walked onto it: Hit by an IED.

injects.label: Aid supply box off target (3)
injects.text: The last Humanitarian Aid Supply Box of the morning landed near grid 18T TL 59753 21954 (40.81346, -77.84844), play square D3. The first force to deliver it intact to the Marala Town office earns the town's thanks. Do not open it.
injects.note: [Optional] Humanitarian Aid Supply Box. First wing to deliver it intact: adjustment, diplomatic +5. If it reaches the town after ENDEX, it does not count.

injects.label: ENDEX warning
injects.text: ENDEX in 10 minutes. Finish current tasks, do not start new contention, and send your commander a final site status by radio. At ENDEX, hold in place and account for every cadet, radio and training rifle.
injects.note: Send at 0750. No POC action.

injects.label: Mayor warning
injects.text: The mayor is alarmed by the incidents of the last half hour. She warns both forces: one more act of provocation and she will close her office to the force responsible.
injects.note: Send when escalation reaches Tension. No scoring; the warning is real: use the town office override if a wing provokes again.

injects.label: The AOC restraint
injects.text: Both national commands are concerned about a wider conflict. For the next 10 minutes, start no new contention and keep fireteams at least 50 m from the other force. Use the liaison channel before any move toward a held site.
injects.note: Send when escalation reaches Crisis. White cell enforces: contention started inside the 10 minutes earns a Provocation call.

injects.label: Operational pause
injects.text: OPERATIONAL PAUSE. Both governments have agreed to a 5-minute pause. All fireteams halt in place. Commanders exchange at least one liaison message proposing a way to lower tension before movement resumes.
injects.note: Send at Brink. Pause the board clock for 5 minutes if needed. Resume after both wings send a liaison message.
